name: CSO_DB_ABUSE
description: This table contains records of message abuse reports.

columns.name: COMMENTS
columns.description: Comments associated with the abuse report.

columns.name: DATE_ADDED
columns.description: This is the datetime that the record was added to the repository.

columns.name: DATE_MODIFIED
columns.description: Datetime record was last modified in repository.

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the abusive message.

columns.name: RECORD_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: TOPIC_ID
columns.description: This is the GUID reference to the abusive topic

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: Field that allows to have types of Abuse. Values 1-Normal.

columns.name: USER_ID
columns.description: This is the obsolete GUID reference to the user that reported the abuse.

columns.name: USER_NAME
columns.description: Full name of user that reported the abuse.

columns.name: USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: This is the ID of the user that reported the abuse.
